label: 任意有理数列逐项平移，16 项
litex:
claim:
    ? forall u fn(k N) Q, c Q:
        sum(1,16,fn(k N) Q {u(k)+c})=sum(1,16,u)+16*c
    sum(1,16,fn(k N) Q {u(k)+c})=sum(1,16,fn(k N) Q {u(k)})+sum(1,16,fn(k N) Q {c})=sum(1,16,u)+sum(1,16,fn(k N) Q {c})=sum(1,16,u)+16*c
lean: ∀ (u : ℕ → ℚ) (c : ℚ), (∑ k ∈ Finset.range 16, (u (k+1) + c)) = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range 16, u (k+1)) + 16*c

methods.expanded:
by
  intro u c
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  ring

note: Two routes prove the identical statement; expanded is deliberately the general unfolding route, formula is the efficient direct Lean baseline. Litex range 1..N corresponds to Lean k+1 for k in range N.
reject_litex:
forall u fn(k N) Q, c Q:
    sum(1,16,fn(k N) Q {u(k)+c})=sum(1,16,u)+17*c

label: 平方差证书，0 条无关假设
litex:
claim:
    ? forall x,y R:
            2*x*y <= x^2+y^2
    x^2+y^2-2*x*y=(x-y)^2 >= 0

methods.only_certificate:
by
  intro x y
  nlinarith only [sq_nonneg (x-y)]
methods.lemma:
by
  intro x y
  exact two_mul_le_add_sq x y

note: Artificial context-load control: the extra nonnegative variables are irrelevant to the conclusion. Their quantification and assumptions are identical on both sides; this is not a harder mathematical theorem.
